answer_1.quote: Radiology report generation plays a crucial role in chest X-ray interpretation, requiring highly specialized domain knowledge ... We evaluate our model using three publicly available radiology report generation datasets: MIMIC-CXR, CHEXPERT-PLUS, and IU X-RAY.

answer_2.quote: Lexical Metrics. Following previous research, BLEU-1/4, ROUGE-L, and METEOR are adopted for evaluating the languages of generated outputs. Clinical Metrics. We evaluate the factual accuracy using several metrics. Specifically, RG-F1 and RG-ER evaluate the entity-level factuality and RadCliQ aligns with the preference of radiologists. For observation evaluation, 14 Macro-F1, 14 Micro-F1, 5 Macro-F1 and 5 Micro-F1 are used.
